hexxysable.page.basics.navimancy.intro: While various biological, mechanical, or otherwise media-infused creations are able to break from the environment, they are either physically restrained or unable to host solid construction. With the helping hand of the Naval Corps, I have devised methods of assembling and controlling portions of the world as rigid, separated physics objects called $(thing)Ships$().
hexxysable.page.basics.navimancy.space.w: $(thing)World Space$() is the playable area where $(thing)Ships$() are rendered and interacted with. Any forces or torques applied in $(thing)World Space$() are considered global and will affect the $(thing)Ships$() regardless of orientation or scale. Any offset is calculated from the $(l:patterns/navimancy#hexxysable:com/world)Center of Mass$() in $(thing)World Space$().
hexxysable.page.basics.navimancy.space.m: $(thing)Sable Plot or Model Space$() is the hidden coordinate space where a $(thing)Ship$()'s blocks are stored and referenced. Forces and torques in $(thing)Model Space$() are local to the Ship and follow its orientation and pose scale. Position offsets are measured from the $(l:patterns/navimancy#hexxysable:com/model)Center of Mass$() in Model Space.$(br2)$(thing)Body Space$() uses the same local axes, but its origin is the Center of Mass at (0, 0, 0).
hexxysable.page.basics.navimancy.forces_: $(thing)Forces$() are linear pushes or pulls applied to a $(thing)Ship$() at a given position offset from the Center of Mass in a given reference space.$(br2)$(thing)Torques$() are rotational pushes or pulls applied to a $(thing)Ship$() at a given position offset from the Center of Mass in a given reference space.
Moves the casting Wisp into $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/model_body)Model Space$().
Moves the casting Wisp into $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/world)World Space$().
hexxysable.page.navimancy.interop.hexica: Takes a mesh and creates a $(thing)Ship$() from its points. All positions must be in ambit. The cost is one shard per position.
hexxysable.entry.navimancy.interop.hexod: Takes a $(thing)Ship$(), an axial vector for new gravity, and a strength scalar relative to standard pull. Costs one dust per kg of mass.

Pushes the remaining twentieths of a second that $(l:interop/hexodus_navimancy#hexodus:change_gravity)$(action)Gravitate$() will affect a $(thing)Ship$(). Zero if the $(thing)Ship$() is not under the effects of $(l:interop/hexodus_navimancy#hexodus:change_gravity)$(action)Gravitate$().

Pushes the direction that $(l:interop/hexodus_navimancy#hexodus:change_gravity)$(action)Gravitate$() is attempting to drag a $(thing)Ship$(), or $(l:casting/influences)$(thing)Null$() if the $(thing)Ship$() is not under the effects of $(l:interop/hexodus_navimancy#hexodus:change_gravity)$(action)Gravitate$().

Pushes the scaling factor of $(l:interop/hexodus_navimancy#hexodus:change_gravity)$(action)Gravitate$()'s gravity compared to baseline, or $(l:casting/influences)$(thing)Null$() if the $(thing)Ship$() is not under the effects of $(l:interop/hexodus_navimancy#hexodus:change_gravity)$(action)Gravitate$().
Pushes the direction of $(thing)Gravity$() acting on a $(thing)Ship$().
Pushes strength of $(thing)Gravity$() acting on a $(thing)Ship$() compared to baseline.
hexxysable.page.navimancy.interop.moreio: Takes a $(thing)Ship$() and returns that $(thing)Ship$()'s slug.
Returns the $(thing)Ship$()'s moment of inertia tensor as a 3x3 matrix.
hexxysable.page.navimancy.patterns.pos: Takes a position on a $(thing)Ship$() and returns the associated $(thing)Ship$().
hexxysable.page.navimancy.patterns.zone_: Analogous to $(l:patterns/entities#hexcasting:zone_entity)Zone Distillation$(), but instead returns a list of $(thing)Ships$().
hexxysable.page.navimancy.patterns.com.w: Analogous to $(l:patterns/basics#hexcasting:entity_pos/eye)Compass Purification$(), but instead returns the position of a $(thing)Ship$()'s Center of Mass in $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/world)World Space$().
hexxysable.page.navimancy.patterns.com.m: Analogous to $(l:patterns/basics#hexcasting:entity_pos/eye)Compass Purification$(), but instead returns the position of a $(thing)Ship$()'s Center of Mass in $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/model_body)Model Space$().
hexxysable.page.navimancy.patterns.mass: Takes either a $(thing)Ship$() or a block position and returns the Ship mass or block mass respectively.
hexxysable.page.navimancy.patterns.rot.e: Returns the $(thing)Ship$()'s orientation as Euler Angles using the YXZ reference frame in radians.
hexxysable.page.navimancy.patterns.scale: Returns the $(thing)Ship$()'s current Sable pose scale.
hexxysable.page.navimancy.patterns.aabb: Returns the minimum and maximum corners of the $(thing)Ship$()'s AABB in $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/model_body)Model Space$().$(br2)Maybe using this with $(thing)Hexstruction$() would allow you to disassemble the Ship...
hexxysable.page.navimancy.patterns.spell: Takes in a list of positions to use to create a $(thing)Ship$(). All positions must be in ambit. The cost is one shard per position.

Sets the given $(thing)Ship$()'s Sable pose scale. The size must be between 1/16 and 16. Cost is one shard times the absolute scale difference.$(br2)In Sable 2.0.3 this changes rendering and coordinate transforms; Rapier collider and inertia rescaling are not exposed.

Due to the latent power of Navimancy, applying $(thing)Forces$() and $(thing)Torques$() to $(thing)Ships$(), Nature extracts a toll. That cost can be calculated as such:$(br)[tex+C=0.1+10\times(\frac{\vec{F}}{60\times\\m\times10})^{2}\times\sqrt{\frac{m}{1000}}]$(br)Where [latex,\vec{F}] is the length of the $(thing)Force$() or $(thing)Torque$() and $(o)m$() is the $(thing)Ship$()'s mass.$(br2)This means that when pushing a 1Mg $(thing)Ship$() to 10 blocks/second in one cast (whose duration is 1/60th of a second, hence the 60), it will cost me 10.1 dust.

A cast queues its force or torque until Sable's next pre-physics step, where it is integrated exactly once using that substep's duration. Repeated casts still increase total acceleration and media use.

Applies a $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/forces_torques)Force$() at a given $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/world)World Space$() position. The position is any offset from the $(l:patterns/navimancy#hexxysable:com/world)Center of Mass$() in $(thing)World Space$().
Applies a $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/forces_torques)Torque$() specified by the vector in $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/world)World Space$().

Applies a $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/forces_torques)Force$() at a given $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/model_body)Model Space$() position. The position is any offset from the $(l:patterns/navimancy#hexxysable:com/model)Center of Mass$() in $(thing)Model Space$().
Applies a $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/forces_torques)Torque$() specified by the vector in $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/model_body)Model Space$()

Applies a $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/forces_torques)Force$() at a given $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/model_body)Body Space$() position. The position is any offset from the Center of Mass in $(thing)Body Space$() which is always (0, 0, 0).
Applies a $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/forces_torques)Torque$()  specified by the vector in $(l:basics/navimancy#hexxysable:page/space/model_body)Body Space$().
